title: Annual Paint The Town, Saturday June 16
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder June 12, 2018

Annual “Paint The Town” en plein air event will be held Saturday, June 16 from 9:00 am – noon.

Watch for Guild of Harwich Artists in the following locations:

Harwich Port

• Dib Carlson – oil ~ Hot Stove Saloon

• John Glass – oil ~ Hot Stove Saloon

• Beverly Mack – watercolor ~ Bank Area

• Donna Tavano watercolor ~ Dr. Gravity

Wychmere Harbor

• Katherine Vacca watercolor ~ Town Pier

• Chris Banks oil ~ Overlook

• Peggy and Rich Orbon~ Overlook

Saquatucket Harbor

• Barbara Hagman

• Bill Maloney

Harwich Center

• Maryrose Reynolds – watercolor ~ Brooks Park

• Ellen Cuddy – acrylic ~ Brooks Park

• Michael Rudden – watercolor ~ Church

Paint The Town – Wet Sale 12:30: Plein air artists will bring their newly painted works to the Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak Street, Harwich. The paint might still be wet, but their morning work will be available for purchase!

Join us for our June Monthly Meeting at 1:00 followed by a free, “Make It and Take It” art event until 4:00 PM.
